title: exists local section overMap of finiteFree retract
statement:
Let p:M→N be an epimorphism of module sheaves on C/U. If N is a displayed retract of a finite power of the rank-one free module, then after a covering sieve of U the restriction of p admits a section. Assume abelian sheafification and local-bijectivity comparisons on every slice.

Precise quantified statement:
theorem exists_local_section_overMap_of_finiteFree_retract
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    [∀ U : C, HasSheafify (J.over U) AddCommGrpCat.{max u v}]
    [∀ U : C, (J.over U).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max u v}]
    (R : Sheaf J RingCat.{max u v}) (U : C)
    {M N : SheafOfModules.{max u v} (R.over U)} (p : M ⟶ N) [Epi p]
    (n : ℕ) (i : N ⟶ ∏ᶜ fun _ : Fin n ↦ unit (R.over U))
    (q : (∏ᶜ fun _ : Fin n ↦ unit (R.over U)) ⟶ N) (hi : i ≫ q = 𝟙 N) :
    ∃ S : Sieve U, S ∈ J U ∧ ∀ (V : C) (f : V ⟶ U), S f →
      ∃ s : (overMap.{max u v} R f).obj N ⟶ (overMap R f).obj M,
        s ≫ (overMap R f).map p = 𝟙 _

Notions used: [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [def-pur-localized-ringed-site].

proof.text: Apply finite-free local lifting to the retraction from the finite free sheaf, identified with the finite biproduct. Compose its lift with the displayed inclusion of the target. The splitting equation follows from the lifting equation and the original retraction.
